(def ^:private quote-string
  (fn [s]
    (let [buffer (BootstrapPrinterStringBuffer. nil)
          length (.-length s)]
      (.append buffer "\"")
      (loop [i 0 start 0]
        (if (< i length)
          (let [end (inc i)
                code (.charCodeAt s i)
                escaped (if (> code 92) nil
                          (get char-escapes (suss.bootstrap/string-slice s i end)))]
            (if escaped
              (do
                (if (< start i)
                  (.append buffer (suss.bootstrap/string-slice s start i))
                  nil)
                (.append buffer escaped)
                (recur end end))
              (recur end start)))
          (do
            (if (< start length)
              (.append buffer (suss.bootstrap/string-slice s start length))
              nil)
            (.append buffer "\"")
            (.toString buffer)))))))
